# ClaimPaid

> ClaimPaid is AI-powered revenue cycle management (RCM) software for medical billing teams and billing companies. It recovers denied claim revenue through denial workflows, automated appeal letters, timely-filing tracking, and a private AI assistant grounded in payer policy documents.

## What ClaimPaid does

- **Denial management**: Track every denied claim through a structured appeal pipeline from denial to paid.
- **Automated appeal letters**: Generates payer-specific appeal letters from denial reason codes, with 8 built-in templates plus custom per-organization templates.
- **Timely filing tracker**: Deadline tracking for major US payers (Aetna 120 days, Cigna 180, UnitedHealthcare 90, Anthem 180, Medicare 365, NY Medicaid 90, Humana 180).
- **Claim scrubber**: 13 pre-billing validation rules catch errors before claims go out.
- **Smart worklists**: Prioritized daily work queues for billers, sorted by dollar impact and deadline urgency.
- **835 ERA import / 837P export**: Standard healthcare EDI transaction support.
- **Prior authorization tracking**: Manage auths and link them to appeals.
- **Payer Playbook**: Searchable database of payer-specific billing rules and appeal tactics.
- **Reports**: 5 exportable CSV reports (aging, denial patterns, productivity, payer performance, revenue recovery).
- **ClaimPaid AI** (separate product at /ai/): A private AI assistant over your own documents. Upload PDFs/policies, ask questions in plain language, get cited answers. Runs on private infrastructure — no data sent to third-party AI APIs.

## Pricing

- **RCM Starter** — $199/month: core RCM (claims, denials, appeals, worklists, reports).
- **RCM Pro + AI** — $499/month: everything in Starter plus ClaimPaid AI, automation pack, API access.
- **ClaimPaid AI** (standalone) — $99/month: the private document AI only, at claimpaid.io/ai/.
- **Enterprise** — custom pricing.
- All paid plans include a 1-month free trial.

## Who it's for

Medical billing companies, independent billing services, hospital and physician practice billing departments, and revenue cycle teams that lose revenue to claim denials and want systematic denial recovery.

## Key facts

- Web-based SaaS; multi-tenant with per-organization data isolation; role-based access (owner/biller/viewer).
- Built by a revenue-cycle practitioner (not a generic SaaS team).
- Support: support@claimpaid.io
- Site: https://claimpaid.io/
- ClaimPaid AI: https://claimpaid.io/ai/

## Guides

In-depth, practical guides for medical billing teams (also at https://claimpaid.io/blog/):

- **How to Appeal a Denied Medical Claim: Step-by-Step** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/how-to-appeal-denied-claim/ — denial reason codes, appeal deadlines, documentation, letter structure, follow-up cadence.
- **Timely Filing Limits by Payer 2026** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/timely-filing-limits-by-payer-2026/ — submission deadlines for Aetna, Cigna, UHC, Anthem, Medicare, Humana, NY Medicaid (verify against your payer contract).
- **7 Most Common Claim Denial Reasons & How to Fix Each** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/top-claim-denial-reasons-fixes/ — CO-16, eligibility, CO-197, CO-96, CO-97, coding errors, CO-29, with fixes and prevention.
- **837P vs 835 Explained** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/837p-vs-835-explained/ — the claim submission file vs the remittance advice file, plus 999 and 277CA acknowledgments.
- **How to Write a Prior Authorization Appeal Letter** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/prior-authorization-appeal-letter/ — template outline, medical-necessity documentation, peer-to-peer review.
- **What Is Claim Scrubbing?** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/what-is-claim-scrubbing/ — pre-submission claim validation, clean-claim rate, what scrubbers check.

- **What Is a Good Clean Claim Rate? Benchmarks Explained** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/clean-claim-rate-benchmarks/ — clean claim rate formula, 90%/95% benchmarks, what drags it down, how to improve it.
- **Denial Management KPIs Every Billing Team Should Track** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/denial-management-kpis/ — denial rate, overturn rate, days in A/R, net collection rate, cost to collect, aged A/R.
- **What Are Crossover Claims? Medicare-Medicaid Billing Explained** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/crossover-claims-explained/ — COBA auto-forwarding for dual-eligible patients, when crossover doesn't fire, manual secondary billing.
- **Coordination of Benefits (COB): How It Affects Claims** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/coordination-of-benefits-guide/ — primary vs secondary rules, birthday rule, fixing CO-22 denials, prevention.
- **ERA vs EOB: What's the Difference?** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/era-vs-eob-difference/ — 835 electronic remittance advice vs paper EOB, auto-posting, ERA enrollment.
- **Common Billing Modifiers (25, 59, 91, 76) Explained** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/medical-billing-modifiers-guide/ — modifier 25/59/91/76 meanings, when to use each, CO-97 bundling denials.
- **Place of Service Codes: What Billers Need to Know** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/place-of-service-codes/ — POS codes 11/19/22/24/02/10, facility vs non-facility payment, POS denials.
- **How Long Does Provider Credentialing Take?** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/provider-credentialing-timeline/ — 90-120 day timeline, CAQH, primary source verification, delay causes, how to speed it up.
- **Patient Eligibility Verification Checklist** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/eligibility-verification-checklist/ — 10 pre-visit checks, real-time 270/271, preventing eligibility denials.
- **Write-Off vs Adjustment vs Bad Debt: What's the Difference?** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/write-off-vs-adjustment/ — contractual adjustments, write-offs, bad debt — definitions, accounting, compliance guardrails.
- **How to Fight a Timely Filing Denial** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/fight-timely-filing-denial/ — CO-29 appeals with 277CA proof, exception cases, prevention.
- **RCM Software Buyer's Guide: What to Look For** — https://claimpaid.io/blog/rcm-software-buyers-guide/ — evaluation criteria — scrubbing, denial workflow, ERA, eligibility, reporting, integration, pricing.
